info.title: MonoVM.Whois command line tool
info.description: Command line domain WHOIS/RDAP lookup and availability checker, powered by MonoVM.Whois.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: monovm-whois — domain WHOIS and RDAP lookups

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit JSON instead of a table.

options.name: --trace
options.description: Show which rule decided each verdict.

options.name: --tlds
options.description: Comma-separated suffixes to try for a bare label (default: .com,.net,.org,.info).

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Per-lookup timeout (default: 10 for WHOIS, 30 for RDAP).

options.name: --parallel
options.description: How many lookups to run at once (default: 8).

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Do not reuse replies within this run.

options.name: --servers
options.description: List every suffix the bundled table serves.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this message.
exit codes:
0  every name resolved to a verdict
1  at least one lookup failed or was not usable
2  the command line could not be read

arguments.name: DOMAIN
arguments.description:
A domain name. Without a suffix, the popular ones are tried.
URLs, subdomains and internationalised names are all accepted.
